_source: Common Stack Overflow / quick-start tutorial pattern
_source_url: Pattern observed in many EC2 quick-start tutorials and StackOverflow answers (e.g. 'I just want to SSH to my instance')
_pattern_description: Classic developer mistake: SSH (port 22) opened to 0.0.0.0/0 with a 'TODO: restrict to my IP' comment that never gets done. Plus unrestricted egress. Among the most common AWS misconfigurations encountered in production.
